test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Select the grammatically correct sentence.**

options.text: The scholastic arguments of the scientist had a great impact on the visiting students.
The scholastic arguments of an scientist had the great impact on the visiting students.
A scholastic arguments of the scientist had the great impact on the visiting students.
The scholastic arguments of a scientist had an great impact on the visiting students.

solution:
The correct answer is **"The scholastic arguments of the scientist had a great impact on the visiting students."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence uses the correct article "**the**" before "**scientist**" because it refers to a specific scientist mentioned earlier in the context.
 
• The adjective "**scholastic**" describes the nature of the arguments and is correctly placed before the noun.
 
• The verb "**had**" is in the past tense, which is appropriate since the impact of the arguments has already occurred.
 
• The adjective "**great**" is used to describe the extent of the impact and is correctly placed before the noun "**impact**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** The indefinite article "**an**" is incorrect because it does not refer to a specific scientist. The adjective "**great**" should also come before "**impact**."
 
• **Option 3:** The indefinite article "**a**" is incorrect because it does not refer to a specific scientist. The adjective "**great**" should also come before "**impact**."
 
• **Option 4**: The indefinite article "**a**" is correct, but the adjective "**an**" before "**great**" is incorrect. The definite article "**the**" should be used before "**scientist**" to refer to a specific scientist.
